name: KINEMA VR
summary:
Experience the Ages of Cinema. Film history becomes a place you can explore.

KINEMA VR is a virtual reality film museum. From the lobby of a grand movie palace, you enter seven halls, each representing a different era:

• Pre-cinema (1830–1890): a fairground tent featuring fully functional optical toys—magic lantern, thaumatrope, zoetrope, praxinoscope, kinetoscope, mutoscope, and camera obscura.
• Early Cinema (1895–1910): load the reel into the cinematograph and start the projection.
